Scored-read reread 2026-11-11: Volume 1 files changed to fill named proof gaps. Numbered statements used as later premises keep their numbers. Binet's formula is no longer called proved in the sums chapter before a square root exists; the linear-algebra solution of the Fibonacci-matrix exercise still derives it. Roots of unity now factor only after a root is shown to give a linear factor. |P| is Lipschitz on a disc. The p-series limits and the integral's endpoint continuity are written.
